claims.statement: After a consultation with R. K. Fox in New York, Tom Allen agreed to accept James Elliott's challenge to fight him for $1,000 and the championship of America, within six weeks of signing articles and within 1,000 miles of New Orleans.
W. E. Harding was to go to Chicago with Tom Allen on Saturday to arrange the match with Elliott.
